definitions.gloss: side job; side business; secondary occupation
definitions.explanation: work done in addition to one's main job, often for extra income

examples.japanese: {副業|ふくぎょう}を{始|はじ}めた。
{会社|かいしゃ}が{副業|ふくぎょう}を{解禁|かいきん}した。
examples.english: The company lifted its ban on side jobs.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}は{副業|ふくぎょう}でライターをしている。
examples.english: On weekends, I work as a freelance writer on the side.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{副|ふく} (secondary, sub-) + {業|ぎょう} (business, occupation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {副業|ふくぎょう} (side job) ↔ {本業|ほんぎょう} (main job)

MODERN CONTEXT:
In Japan, {副業|ふくぎょう} has become increasingly common and accepted:
- Many companies now permit side jobs
- Popular forms include freelance writing, online tutoring, consulting
- Some do it for income, others for skill development or fulfillment

RELATED WORDS:
- {兼業|けんぎょう} - holding multiple jobs
- {複業|ふくぎょう} - multiple careers (different kanji, more equal weight)
- ダブルワーク - double work
- {在宅|ざいたく}ワーク - work from home
- フリーランス - freelance
